pages.text:
Heat machines hold heat (HU) in a buffer. Their temperature climbs from 20°C when empty to the machine's maximum when full.
Heat only flows from a hotter block into a colder one: through touching heat faces, or through Thermodynamic Conduits.
# Why temperature matters
- The Thermoelectric Plant makes more FE per HU the hotter it runs.
- The Fiberizer needs 800°C, the Arcforge Furnace 1,200°C.
- A Steam Boiler Array makes better steam the hotter it gets.

# Moving a lot of heat
Thermodynamic Conduits carry 50, 200, 800 or 51,200 HU/t by tier. For more, or between big multiblocks, use a Heat Pipe.
# Limited by connections
When a heat, FE or steam producer makes more than what's connected takes, its buffer fills and it slows down. Its GUI and Jade then show a yellow line, such as "Limited by connections: 3,200 / 50,400 HU/t": what goes out against what it could give. Connect a faster conduit, a Heat Pipe, or more consumers.
